GARDENOS → EDENOS CORE EXTRACTION MAP v0.1

RETAIN / GENERALIZE FROM GARDENOS
- identity and hardware capability model
- hardware abstraction
- sensor/actuator services
- Node/module discovery concepts
- safe outputs and unknown-hardware non-actuation
- local deterministic rules/automation
- configuration and persistence
- calibration
- networking/discovery
- API concepts
- OTA/update/recovery
- diagnostics/health/events
- local-first operation
- resource discipline
- authoritative implementation principle
- user-data separation and migration
- adapter-not-owner integrations

REMAIN IN GARDENOS
- plants and plant database
- beds/zones/garden spatial semantics
- irrigation/watering strategies
- crop/soil biological knowledge
- agriculture-specific automation semantics
- garden-specific UI language

EXTEND IN EDENOS CORE FOR MACHINES
- motion provider abstraction
- energy provider/state
- payload/tool interface
- machine safety/interlocks
- position/localization quality
- mission/job runtime
- Home/Dock
- machine buses
- service/maintenance metrics
- graceful capability degradation

MIGRATION RULE
TRACE → CONSOLIDATE → GENERALIZE ONLY WHAT IS REUSABLE → EXTRACT CONTRACT → VERIFY GARDENOS → REUSE → REMOVE DUPLICATION.
